summary.fixedIssue: Server-side Drop publish validation now mirrors the CMS form guardrails for admin create/update, creator submission/edit, and admin creator-submission approval.
warnings: Archive is implemented as hard delete in the current admin drops workflow; a separate reversible archive state is not present and is documented as deferred.
Creator assignment is optional for admin-created public content drops, but required for creator-submitted drops and subscriber-only drops.
deferred: Add a reversible archive status if product operations require restore/history beyond current delete behavior.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Admin modal uses zod form validation; admin POST requires admin auth, trusted origin, and shared server publish validation before writing.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Invalid drafts cannot become visible Drops through direct API writes.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: New active Drops notify only after the validated write succeeds.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Content Drops must include locked asset pointers before publication.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Published Drops keep stable Drop ids for downstream click, impression, unlock, and creator attribution.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Admin-created Drops may stay unassigned; creator-submitted Drops are forced to caller uid; subscriber-only Drops require creator assignment.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Creator routing remains optional for general Drops and explicit for creator-owned or subscription-gated Drops.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Drop notifications carry Drop context regardless of creator assignment.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Subscription access requires a creator lane before unlock can use creator subscription entitlement.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Unlock analytics includes creator_id only when a creator exists.
workflowMap.validation: validator checks optional admin creator field and required creator-submitted validation

workflowMap.currentGuard: Cover uploads are routed through server endpoints; publish validation requires a valid http/https cover or public preview URL.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Published cards have a real public-safe cover or fail before publishing.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Manual notification draft blocks without preview image; activation notifications use Drop imageUrl after validation.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Cover is public-safe and does not grant locked asset access.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Cover does not affect metric attribution.
workflowMap.validation: admin form validation, server publish validation, content/media pipeline validator

workflowMap.currentGuard: Content Drops require at least one contentUrl/contentUrls entry at form and server layers; public feeds sanitize protected URLs; content proxy verifies ownership/unlock.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: A published content Drop cannot be empty and public pages do not leak raw content URLs.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Asset presence does not send notifications by itself.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Locked assets stay behind /api/drops/content entitlement checks.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Viewer and unlock analytics keep Drop id attribution.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms workflow tests and content-media pipeline checks

workflowMap.currentGuard: Form and server validation require unlockCost to be a finite number >= 0; unlock route rejects invalid Drop configuration before spending balance.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Negative prices cannot be published through the CMS API.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Price does not affect notification dispatch.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Unlock deduction remains atomic and source-aware.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Unlock telemetry records unlock_cost and creator_id where available.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms workflow tests, admin-drop-form tests, payment/unlock tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Current category/tier controls are Drop type, tags, and requiresActiveSubscription; no separate tier taxonomy exists.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Discovery filters use approved tag labels and subscription-gated Drops stay explicit.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Notification dispatch is independent from tags.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: requiresActiveSubscription is validated with creator assignment and enforced during unlock.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Card and unlock events include Drop category/type and tags.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms validator and existing Drop form tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Form checks validUntil > validFrom; server validation now enforces the same rule; mutations resolve canonical active/scheduled/expired status from timing.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Bad windows cannot publish and public pages receive resolved status.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Activation notification keys include Drop id and validFrom.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Expired Drops do not remove already-owned entitlements.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Live window affects visibility but not metric identity.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms workflow tests and drop-status tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Admin create/update and approval validate the full publish state before approved or live writes; public feed hides pending/rejected Drops.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Only approved, complete, active Drops render on discovery.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: sendGlobalDropNotification is called after a validated live transition and uses deterministic activation key.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Publish does not grant entitlement; unlock remains separate.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Published Drops preserve ids for impression/click/unlock events.
workflowMap.requiredFix: Added validation on admin POST and approval/update.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Queue membership is admin-only, trusted-origin, deduped, normalized, and projected into visible admin lifecycle labels.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Queue changes do not directly expose Drops until runtime schedules/activates them.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Queue state does not affect existing entitlements.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Queue state is not a separate public metric source.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms validator and queue lifecycle tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Scheduled runtime marks eligible queued Drops active and sends return-live notifications with deterministic activation keys and notification idempotency.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Auto-return live Drops can reappear without duplicate push spam.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Return-live dispatch uses targeted notification identity and browser tags.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Existing owners are excluded from targeted return-live notifications where owner lookup succeeds.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Queue runtime records heartbeats, outcomes, and warnings.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms workflow tests and push-notification tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Runtime resolves expired active Drops from validUntil and can auto-queue if enabled; Drop cards hide expired locked Drops.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Expired locked Drops stop appearing as unlockable cards.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Expiration alone does not notify unless queue return-live later triggers.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Owned users keep library/viewer access through entitlement.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Runtime warnings expose stale or failed status reconciliation.
workflowMap.validation: queue lifecycle tests and admin-cms validator

workflowMap.currentGuard: Current admin workflow supports delete with confirmation and surface invalidation; reversible archive state is not implemented.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Deleted Drops are removed from user-facing surfaces after invalidation.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Direct content retrieval fails once Drop document is removed; prior ownership records may remain for audit/history.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Historical telemetry keeps prior Drop ids; deleted Drop records are not retained by this route.
workflowMap.requiredFix: Documented delete-vs-archive behavior and deferred reversible archive.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Edit mode hydrates existing Drop values; server validates merged existing+incoming publish state before status-affecting updates.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Partial metadata edits cannot accidentally blank a published Drop into invalid state.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Only inactive-to-active timing transitions send activation notifications.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Content asset edits still require a valid content asset set for content Drops.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Drop id remains stable across metadata edits.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Public route filters active Drops and sanitized client payloads render through DropGrid/DropCard.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Published approved Drops render without exposing protected content URLs.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Click routing and previews stay independent from notification dispatch.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Unlock/viewer remains required for content bytes.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Drop card impressions and details clicks include drop_id.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms validator, server-drops tests, Drop card tests

workflowMap.currentGuard: Activation and return-live notifications use deterministic idempotency; manual admin notifications use notification identity and duplicate reporting.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Admins can notify users without duplicate visible notifications for the same Drop lifecycle.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Browser tag and document id prevent duplicate display/creation.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Return-live notification excludes existing owners when owner lookup succeeds.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Notification dispatch outcomes are recorded for Debug/admin funnel.

workflowMap.currentGuard: Discovery, details, click, impression, and unlock paths include drop_id; creator unlock telemetry includes creator_id when available.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: User behavior on published Drops feeds admin truth with stable Drop identity.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Notification funnel remains separate from Drop discovery/unlock attribution.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Unlock telemetry is emitted only after successful server transaction.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: drop_id and creator_id are present where source truth allows them.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms validator and analytics event contract checks

workflowMap.currentGuard: Unlock uses a server transaction; content proxy requires creator ownership or unlocked content/timestamp; library/viewer use owned Drop ids.
workflowMap.userFacingImpact: Users cannot read locked content without entitlement and repeated unlocks do not double-charge.
workflowMap.notificationImpact: Entitlement state prevents notifying owners during return-live targeting where lookup succeeds.
workflowMap.entitlementImpact: Server remains source of truth for balance, unlock, and content access.
workflowMap.analyticsImpact: Successful unlock writes task/creator telemetry with Drop id and creator id.
workflowMap.validation: admin-cms validator, payment/unlock tests, content-media pipeline tests
